transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I need someone to help me make them stop. There are people who have been constantly watching and monitoring my every move for months now. I can't ignore it anymore.
Have you also had periods of feeling very depressed or unusually energized or needing much less sleep, or has it mainly been the feeling that people are watching and monitoring you?

No, I haven't had any of those mood swings or changes in my sleep; my energy is completely normal. It has really just been this constant feeling that I am being watched and monitored, which has been going on for about ten months now. I just want them to stop tracking me.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences, like hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or feeling that your thoughts are being controlled or broadcast?

No, I haven't heard any voices or seen things that aren't really there. My thoughts are completely my own, and they aren't being controlled or broadcasted at all. It's just the physical tracking and monitoring in the real world that is happening.

Schizophrenia and schizoaffective/bipolar disorders are less likely because there are no prominent mood symptoms or other psychotic features beyond the single delusional theme. The candidate list remains the same.
